arguments.rule_content:
rule YARA_CobaltStrike_Generic {
    meta:
        description = "Detects generic Cobalt Strike beacon patterns in memory or files"
        author = "SOC Team"
        false_positives = ["Packed .NET assemblies, legitimate updaters"]
        remediation = "Whitelist known-good hashes exhibiting this pattern to reduce noise"
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 00 } // .rcd pattern in config
        $http_get = "GET / HTTP/1.1" wide ascii
        $user_agent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" wide ascii
    condition:
        all of ($beacon*) and filesize < 500KB
}

// Whitelist known-good hashes
$whitelist = (
    "a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2" // Microsoft Windows Update KB5034441
)

// Final condition excludes whitelisted hashes
condition:
    not $whitelist and all of ($beacon*) and filesize < 500KB
}

arguments.summary: Advanced Persistent Threat (APT-41) activity detected originating from workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). The compromise began with a phishing email triggering an encoded PowerShell execution from Outlook, leading to the deployment of a ShadowPad variant via a malicious DLL loaded by rundll32.exe. The malware established a C2 beacon to 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS and performed lateral movement via SMB to a finance file server. Indicators confirm attribution to APT-41 (Double Dragon). Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP, resetting the user's credentials, and hardening the affected host.

{
    meta:
        description = "Detects memory-resident Cobalt Strike beacon DLLs"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-09"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 00 00 4C 01 01 00 [1-4] 00 00 00 00 } // MZ header + PE + COFF magic
        $b = "CryptEncrypt" wide ascii
        $c = "CryptDecrypt" wide ascii
        $d = "WSAStartup" wide ascii
        $e = "LoadLibraryA" wide ascii
        $f = "GetProcAddress" wide ascii
        $jitter = "[Jj]itter" wide ascii
    condition:
        uint16(0) == 0x5A4D and // MZ
        $a and 
        4 of ($b, $c, $d, $e, $f) and 
        $jitter
}
